- Departmental miscommunication or siloed design: claims vs. customer-service teams may have differing expectations around mandatory notification, leading to the XOR(skip).

JOIN claim_events ce ON c.claim_id = ce.claim_id
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM claim_events e 
    WHERE e.claim_id = c.claim_id AND e.activity IN ('E','P')

FROM claims c

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM claim_events n 
    WHERE n.claim_id = c.claim_id AND n.activity = 'N'
)

    SELECT 1 FROM claim_events cl

)
